title: Estoy celoso
desc: Jealousy, out loud, before it goes bad
setting: Somebody put an arm around her at a party and you have not spoken for an hour.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.es: ¿Qué te pasa? Andás raro desde la fiesta.
steps.en: What is wrong with you? You have been odd since the party.

options.es: Sí, ando raro. Me puse celoso y no sé qué hacer con eso.
options.en: Yes, I have. I got jealous and I do not know what to do with it.
options.feedback: Named, owned, and handed to her without an accusation. That is the version of this that ends well.
She can see that it is something. Now she has to drag it out of you, and that is its own argument.

options.es: Vos sabés muy bien qué me pasa.
options.en: You know perfectly well what is wrong with me.
options.feedback: That sentence starts a fight about whether she knows, which is not the subject.

options.es: De él y de no saber quién es.
options.en: Of him, and of not knowing who he is.
options.feedback: Honest about the real thing, which is not him. Very hard to argue with.
True as far as it goes. It puts a man in the middle of something that is not about him.

options.es: De todos los que te tocan.
options.feedback: Todos turns one moment into an accusation about her whole life.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.es: Erick es mi primo. Crecimos juntos.
steps.en: Erick is my cousin. We grew up together.

options.es: Ah, puchica. Ya me siento tonto.
options.en: Ah, damn. Now I feel stupid.
options.feedback: Taking the hit lightly and out loud is what stops it from becoming a week.
Accepted. It is a little short for how much you just put her through.

options.es: Y por qué no me lo dijiste.
options.en: And why did you not tell me.
options.feedback: You are now blaming her for not answering a question you never asked.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.es: Tonto no. Pero preguntame la próxima vez.
steps.en: Not stupid. But ask me next time.

options.es: Te lo prometo. Prefiero preguntar que andar así.
options.en: I promise. I would rather ask than go around like this.
options.feedback: A promise, and a reason for it that is about you and not about her.
Accepted. She said something worth answering properly.

options.es: Si no me das motivos, no pregunto.
options.en: If you do not give me reasons, I will not ask.
options.feedback: That puts the condition on her. It undoes the whole conversation.
